BA operating margin improved from 10.0% to 12.3% (2.3‑point rise) whereas AMZN’s interest income only increased from $39 m to $80 m
GOOGL reported 26% YoY revenue growth (23% constant‑currency) while JNJ's worldwide sales grew 12.6% YoY in its fiscal Q1 2018

NEE recorded a $25 million reduction to retained earnings from the new revenue standard, while Microsoft reported no comparable hit
